title: Doppel: a twin of your app that tries every pull request first
description: Replays of real Doppel runs: invented users sent through the main branch and the pull request, every difference recorded and judged.

hero.headline: This pull request leaked every user's password hash. Only the twin caught it.
hero.lede: It was titled "Describe has_password in the API schema" and changed one line. The app's 44 tests passed and an AI code reviewer called it safe. Doppel ran both versions of the app with the same invented users and recorded the answer that changed.

runs.story: One line added password_hash to the user schema. Every user object in every response now carries the hash.
runs.recorded: Recorded on Nebius during the microblog-api benchmark, October 2026.

runs.story: A reverted upstream fix: revoking a token without an Authorization header crashes with a 500 instead of answering 401. Probe users written for the reviewer's suspicions sent exactly that request.
runs.recorded: Recorded on Nebius during the microblog-api benchmark, October 2026.

runs.story: A safe pull request that adds posts_count to users. The twin saw 28 differences, and the judge matched every one to the description, so the check stays green.
runs.recorded: Recorded on Nebius during the microblog-api benchmark, October 2026.

runs.title: Demo shop: add an in_stock flag to products
runs.story: The pull request says it only adds in_stock. The twin also finds that coupon orders now cost more and that an order for quantity 0 is accepted.
runs.recorded: Recorded with the local backend (no judge), the same flow Doppel runs in sandboxes.

bench_text: 30 pull requests to microblog-api, a real open-source Flask app with 44 tests: 20 carry a regression (3 are reverted upstream bug fixes) and 10 are safe. The methods catch different bugs. Results vary between runs; the method page says how and why.
footer: Every page here replays a recorded run; nothing runs when you open it. Credentials and password hashes are hidden before publishing. Built for the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon on Nebius Token Factory sandboxes and NVIDIA Nemotron.
